brief: Three instrument lies, one file class. (1) `filmstrip.mjs --scene night` pins t=1230 s, which is day 22.4 hour ~14.7 — the night preset is a day strip; re-pin it to a real night instant (a mid-night hour on a whole day, chosen by the same rule the other presets use) and say in the file how the number was derived. (2) `runlog.mjs` grades a Harness brief 'no-ship' because srcChanged is false — #38 shipped and the dashboard says it failed; make the verdict read the brief's kind so a harness iteration that committed and logged is 'shipped' without source movement (a harness brief that DID touch courtyard.html should still be flagged). (3) A worker that ran >30 s with tokens and exited non-zero currently retires its brief as 'failed'; decide (and document in run-loop.sh) whether it is re-issued once or retired — the cheap, honest rule is one retry, then retire with the rc in the row.
successLooksLike: The night filmstrip shows lit windows and lamp pools; `runlog.mjs` re-run over RUNLOG.jsonl reads #38 as shipped and no other row changes; a simulated rc=1 worker with tokens>0 is handled by the documented rule.
avoid: Do not touch courtyard.html. Do not re-grade any row other than harness rows.
